react.description: A row of actions, usually at the bottom of the card.

parts.description: Holds the title and the subheader.

react.description: Media at the card's edge. A media element (`img`, `video`…) or a component gets `src`; any other element holds the picture as a decorative cover `img` (it needs a height).

props.description: The element: `"img"`, `"video"`, `"picture"`, `"iframe"` and `"audio"` show the media themselves (`src`); other elements hold a cover image; a component (such as `Image`) gets `src`.
